mapper.select: SELECT (CASE WHEN pra.REPORT_STATUS is null THEN #{dataStatus} ELSE pr.DATA_STATUS end) DATA_STATUS, pra.REPORT_STATUS, pra.REPORT_DECR, pr.REQUIREMENT_ID, pr.REQUIREMENT_BASIS, pr.REQUIREMENT_DATE, pr.REQUIREMENT_USER, pr.REVIEW_YESNO, pr.TAR_CUSTOMER, pr.PRD_SCALE, pr.PRD_PERIOD, pr.PRD_RATE, pr.PRD_REQUIREMENT_DETIAL, pr.REQUIREMENT_SOURCE FROM PRODUCT_REQUIREMENT pr LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_REQUIREMENT_ADD pra ON pr.REQUIREMENT_ID = pra.REQUIREMENT_ID WHERE pr.REQUIREMENT_ID = #{requirementId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PRODUCT_REQUIREMENT_ADD WHERE REQUIREMENT_ID = #{requirementId}
